title: Bray's Navy UAP disclosure
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bray's Navy UAP disclosure, about 2021 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions Scott Bray, a US Navy official. Michels says Bray was the person who disclosed information, around 2021 he thinks, about UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs. It is told as a moment when the military spoke openly about the subject.
